evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Selected events are written as textual episodic records containing temporal indices, scene narratives, and when/where/what/who cues linked to their keyframes.

An LLM memory agent iteratively checks sufficiency and cross-event consistency and adjusts event granularity. For Video-EM, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of query-grounded keyframes grouped into events.

The reflection loop removes redundant evidence to produce a minimal sufficient event set. For Video-EM, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of query-grounded keyframes grouped into events.

derived.hybrid_relation: Structured event records remain grounded in the selected keyframes used by the downstream Video-LLM.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 8): During inference, the operative memory component (query-grounded keyframes grouped into events) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
